assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and intermittent dizziness, raising clinical suspicion for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation.
The symptoms are episodic in nature.
The diagnosis is paroxysmal atrial fibrillation.
Cardiac event monitoring (CPT 93271) is indicated to correlate rhythm disturbances with clinical events and capture arrhythmic activity during symptomatic periods.
The CPT code for cardiac event monitoring is 93271.
The clinical indication note reflects the need for rhythm correlation during symptomatic episodes.
The claim addresses the member's current benefit plan determination PR-204.
The diagnosis code I49.9 is supported.
The diagnosis code R42 is supported.
The claim references the clinical indication note as supporting documentation.
